reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, launch_date, launch_date + INTERVAL 90 DAY AS review_date
FROM products
WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2024-11-30'
alternatives: SELECT product_id, launch_date, launch_date + 90 AS review_date FROM products WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2024-11-30'
SELECT product_id, launch_date, date_add(launch_date, INTERVAL 90 DAY) AS review_date FROM products WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2024-11-30'

other_way.sql: SELECT product_id, launch_date, launch_date + 90 AS review_date FROM products WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2024-11-30'
other_way.tradeoff: Adding the number 90 keeps a DATE, while the INTERVAL names its unit and gives a TIMESTAMP at midnight.
